multiple.requestChoices: Every enabled upload, re-preview, mode/generation request, external write connection, expiration callback, restart and one-shot post-write failure is nondeterministic. No fixed scripts.
multiple.scope: Two independently uploaded tokens; successful commit of either invalidates the other preview revision. All enabled orderings within the exact bounds are enumerated.

mutants.semantics: Suppress the stored preview revision check while preserving all other commit guards.
Deliver the original expiry callback but deliberately retain a usable pending upload instead of invalidating it.

Retain the usable token after commit by removing both consumed and immediate Map deletion defenses; re-preview allows a second successful commit. Removing only consumed is equivalent while Map deletion remains.

traceContract.normalization: Strip module namespaces through the last ::; reject duplicate normalized variable names.

#set: integer business ID; normalize to sorted unique arrays

traceContract.actor: Upload token index for upload/preview/commit/expire/cleanup; -1 for init/same_write/other_write/restart/stutter.
traceContract.requestedMode: append/replace for upload and preview; append/replace/invalid for commit; empty string otherwise.
traceContract.requestedGeneration: 1 for upload; new successful generation for preview (0 on rejected preview); request generation 0..2 for commit; 0 otherwise. Unissued generations use an invalid opaque value in HTTP replay.
traceContract.fault: true only for a qualified commit with the one-shot post-write COMMIT fault; false for every other action.
traceContract.lastHTTPStatus: Latest completed modeled HTTP response; init=0. Non-HTTP actions preserve the preceding status/code.
traceContract.lastHTTPCode: Empty string for successful HTTP responses and init; exact server error code for rejection or injected failure.
traceContract.businessIds: Initial local listening ID normalizes to 0; token t contains one listening normalized to t+1. Replace sets {t+1}; append unions {t+1}. Actual adapter additionally checks full persistent row/schema snapshots on rejection and rollback.
traceContract.clientMetadata: Maps contain only the latest successful validate/preview response, not inferred server Map contents. Initial generation/counts are 0 and mode is empty. Rejected preview and all commits preserve these maps.
traceContract.revision: Internal equality abstraction of SHA256(total_changes,data_version,schema_version); actual public HTTP status plus persisted row snapshots establishes implementation conformance. Raw revision counters and pendingImports are not observable projection fields. Obsolete preview revision values are quotiented to -1 after a real revision change, preserving every equality guard and every public projection.
traceContract.externalWrites: same_write and other_write each change persisted content but preserve the business ID set. Both invalidate every older preview; shared maximum is two writes, with either connection chosen independently.
traceContract.transactionBoundary: Request body/upload awaits precede each HTTP action. The commit action linearizes synchronous qualification, SQLite BEGIN/validation/writes/COMMIT or ROLLBACK, consumed assignment and Map deletion. No invented pause exists inside that critical section.
traceContract.postWriteFailure: At most one injected failure at real SQLite COMMIT after writes. ROLLBACK preserves rows/schema; total_changes still advances, invalidating older previews. Append returns 409 APPEND_FAILED; replace returns 500 RESTORE_FAILED. Explicit re-preview is required before successful retry.
traceContract.cleanup: Asynchronous filesystem cleanup is a stutter of all public and qualification state. Response latency during unlink is abstracted away; file deletion cannot requalify a token.
traceContract.expiry: expire is delivery of the actual 900000-ms timer callback installed by validate. Preview never installs or renews that timer. No claim about a hard real-time deadline, scheduler fairness or eventual callback delivery.
traceContract.restart: One genuine server process death/new process is represented by clearing all pending tokens while preserving imported business IDs and the client-held preview metadata. Subsequent fresh upload of the other token is possible.
traceContract.safety: versionBound, expiryBound, modeBound, generationBound, restartBound, singleConsumption, refusedCommitUnchanged, successfulCommitResult, tokenDomains and finiteDomain.

fast.tlc: Both declared finite domains must finish complete enumeration.
fast.claim: Apalache is bounded to the explicit fast depths; TLC is complete only for the declared finite domains.

deep.tlc: Same complete finite domains as fast.
deep.claim: Separate deep run; pending, interrupted, missing or timed-out checks are not passes.

profileRationale: Finite-domain bounds are unchanged by profiles. Final-model probes completed single TLC (83,751 generated / 5,552 distinct / queue0 / graph depth10) in2.463s and two_tokens TLC (8,733,905 generated / 318,766 distinct / queue0 / graph depth13) in108.007s. Bounded Apalache depth8 completed in13.902s (single) and63.183s (two_tokens). Initial unquotiented two-token TLC timed out90s and depth12 timed out180s; those probes are not passes. Fast is depth8; deep independently requests depth12. Every final run must establish its own completed TLC enumeration and bounded-check status.
exclusions: unbounded token, preview generation, write, restart or fault counts
SQLite row-copy, trigger and foreign-key atomicity proof (KEJ-73)
malformed JSON, invalid uploads, runtime-busy resources and filesystem failures
concurrent external-connection commits inside the synchronous SQLite transaction; the SQLite write lock is assumed
automatic model-provider calls and browser confirmation behavior are separate implementation evidence
UI cancellation has no server-side cancel-token endpoint; browser-specific tests cover cancelling the confirmation

costProbes.purpose: Provisional local sizing only; not source-stamped final acceptance. Concurrent probes may affect wall time.
